hook: brandish 揮武器炫耀，blandish 甜言蜜語，bristle 怒髮衝冠——化妝間三個鏡子：刀、糖、刺。
script: brandish＝揮舞炫耀。blandish＝奉承討好。bristle＝發怒／豎起。口令：刀不是糖，糖不是刺。

members.senseAnchor: the act of waving; move or swing back and forth
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 刀光鏡: brandish walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「刀光鏡」出場：brandish 一上場梗就黏住——揮舞炫耀。
